hooks.command: in=$(cat); file_path=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null) || file_path=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null) || file_path=''; root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if printf '%s\n' "$file_path" | grep -q '\.context/.*\.json$' && [ -d "$root/.context" ]; then printf '%s | TASK_TRANSITION | file=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$file_path" >> "$root/.context/audit.log" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
